bundleProducts.description: This scratch-proof jacket fits snugly over Yoto Player 4th Gen, standing guard against scuffs, drops and everyday bumps and thumps. With the silicone jacket fitted, you'll still have full access to all its features: the night light, buttons, charging port and headphone jack. Pick it up and go with the built-in carry handle, moving your Player from room to room without missing a beat. Compatible with Yoto Player 4th Gen only and available in four colors.

bundleProducts.description: Yoto Says: Lovable, furry old Grover has discovered that there's a monster at the end of this book! Please don’t turn the page! The classic tale of Grover and the monster hiding at the end of the book is now available for little ears on Yoto! The Monster at the End of this BookLovable, furry old Grover is alarmed to learn that there is a MONSTER at the end of this audiobook! He begs listeners not to turn the pages and tries every wacky way he can think of to keep from reaching the end. Grover is shocked—and little listeners will love—to discover who the monster really is! Another Monster at the End of this BookNow joined by his pal Elmo, Grover has heard that there is ANOTHER MONSTER afoot! Yet again, Grover tries silly ways to stop the listener from reaching the end of the audiobook, but curious little Elmo has another idea...he wants to see who the monster is!
bundleProducts.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Lovable, furry old Grover has discovered that there's a monster at the end of this book! Please don’t turn the page!_**

The classic tale of Grover and the monster hiding at the end of the book is now available for little ears on Yoto!  

_The Monster at the End of this Book_

Lovable, furry old Grover is alarmed to learn that there is a MONSTER at the end of this audiobook! He begs listeners not to turn the pages and tries every wacky way he can think of to keep from reaching the end. Grover is shocked—and little listeners will love—to discover who the monster really is!  

_Another Monster at the End of this Book_

Now joined by his pal Elmo, Grover has heard that there is ANOTHER MONSTER afoot! Yet again, Grover tries silly ways to stop the listener from reaching the end of the audiobook, but curious little Elmo has another idea...he _wants_ to see who the monster is!
